It has tremendous stopping power and can pierce thick armor as easily as thin paper.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 32 |durability = 45 |multishot = 3 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Savage Lynel Bow}} Savage Lynel Bows are [[Bow]]s found in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Hyrule Field]]. [[White-Maned Lynel]]s, [[Silver Lynel]]s, and [[Golden Lynel]]s all use them when fighting. These Bows are part of the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a group of [[Weapon]]s created by [[Lynel]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} They are forged with a special steel found at the peak of [[Death Mountain]], and they have the strength to pierce thick [[Armor]]. Being made of metal, Savage Lynel Bows will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, Savage Lynel Bows will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_032" |Life = 45 |Power = 32 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 28 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = true |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = true |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 3.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 2 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Savage Lynel Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Lynel Bow * Lynel Gear * Mighty Lynel Bow }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Lynel Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK }}
